description: Generates a textured 3D mesh from a text prompt (Meshy Text-to-3D).

prompt.description: Describe what kind of object the 3D model is. Maximum 600 characters.

seed.description: Seed controls whether the node should re-run; results are non-deterministic regardless of seed.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

pose_mode.description: Specify the pose mode for the generated model. Empty string lets the model decide; lower-cased on the wire.

should_remesh.description: When set to false, returns an unprocessed triangular mesh.

style.description: Describe your desired art style of the object.

symmetry_mode.description: Controls symmetry behavior during model generation.

target_polycount.description: Target number of polygons. Only applies when should_remesh=true.

topology.description: Topology of the generated model. Only applies when should_remesh=true.

ultra_mode.description: Run an extra refinement pass for higher-fidelity geometry with finer surface detail. Requires model 'meshy-7' or 'latest'; costs 5 extra credits.
